This minified source is the unmodified official lightweight-page response
captured on 2026-10-17. Source SHA-256:
`e548d543be343288b431ce45a4964ecde1ff362dfa792a3c0a5360b4aa8af91d`.

The app signs a compiled form keyed by the **entire original source**. It is
used only when downloaded bytes match, independent of URL or website. The
original page and library behavior remain in control; different bytes compile
normally. This is a build input, not an automatically executed bootstrap.
